verses.text: “Yahweh, I wish that you would tear open the sky and come down,
Be like a fire that burns twigs
You have done awesome things which we were not expecting you to do;
Since ◄long ago/the world began►, no one [SYN] has ever seen or heard about a God like you;
You help those who joyfully do what is right,
We have all become people who are not fit to worship you;
None of our people worships you,
Yahweh, do not continue to be angry with us;
All of your towns in Judah have become like [MET] deserts;
Your glorious temple on Zion Hill, where our ancestors worshiped you,
Yahweh, you see all those things, so we worry that you will refrain from helping us,
